reviews.title: Perfect Match for Our summer Camp set
reviews.body: Bought this for my 4-year-old’s gymnastics summer camp, and it’s absolutely perfect. We also purchased the matching backpack, water bottle, and bento box, and the whole set is so cute together. The lunch box is roomy enough to fit her bento box, snacks, and ice pack without being bulky. It seems well-made, the zipper works smoothly, and the design is even cuter in person. My daughter loves carrying it and gets excited to use it every day. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a fun, coordinated lunch set for a preschooler or kindergartener!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 10 June 2026
